request.query: Irrational real number choose finitely many coprime rational approximants with rapidly increasing logarithms

items.name: setOf_liouville_eq_irrational_inter_iInter_iUnion
items.type: {x | Liouville x} = {x | Irrational x} ∩ ⋂ n, ⋃ a, ⋃ b, ⋃ (_ : 1 < b), Metric.ball (↑a / ↑b) (1 / ↑b ^ n)

items.name: Liouville.frequently_exists_num
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Liouville x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ᶠ (b : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ a, x ≠ ↑a / ↑b ∧ |x - ↑a / ↑b| < 1 / ↑b ^ n

items.name: forall_liouvilleWith_iff
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, (∀ (p : ℝ), LiouvilleWith p x) ↔ Liouville x

items.name: LiouvilleWith.irrational
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → 1 < p → Irrational x
